vendorClaims.text: Agents test from the screen with plain-language tasks; no SDK, plugins or code changes; bug reports with visuals and severity scores; CI triggers.
Android and desktop today; iOS in development; best for structured/UI-driven mobile genres; very fast-paced gameplay not fully supported yet. No named customers or numbers on the site.
Aug 2026 six-month MoU with QA services firm Side for product development and commercial pilots.
Agents play via screen and touch/keyboard/mouse from plain-English instructions on PC, iOS, Android; console coming soon; optional SDK; multiplayer agents.
Customers save up to 50% on manual QA costs; case studies listed for Stormforge, Hogwarts Legacy and Pokemon Emerald (the latter two look like demos, not customers).
Google Cloud partnership; agents powered by Gemini models (partner blog).
Beta with over 50 game studios (unnamed); built on Amazon Bedrock; JIRA integration; performance bug detection; on AWS Marketplace since Nov 2025.
GDC 2026 update: zero-integration, vision-based detection of physics/rendering/animation bugs with repro steps and video; test cases from prompts or GDDs; autonomous agents in development.
GDC 2026 closed session for 10 indie PC studios to run it on their own builds; no feedback published.

notes: Missing tools to consider: GameDriver, Regression Games, Tencent WeTest, Keywords Studios (Mighty Build and Test: BuildBot/TestBot/ProofBot), Nodemori, Unity Test Framework / Unreal Gauntlet + Automation, PlaytestCloud / Side playtest (with Razer Cortex), Filuta AI, Unakin, QA.tech
